domain.description: Domain name to search (e.g., "stripe.com"). Either domain or companyName is required.

companyName.description: Company name to search. Either domain or companyName is required.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100, default 10)

location.description: Filter by location of the contacts

type.description: Type of email: personal or generic

pattern.description: Most common email pattern for this domain

fullName.description: Full name of the person (alternative to firstName + lastName)

linkedinHandle.description: LinkedIn handle or profile URL of the person

maxDuration.description: Max time in seconds (3-20) for the search to refine results

status.description: Verification status: valid, invalid, accept_all, webmail, disposable, or unknown

regexp.description: Whether the email passes regex validation

gibberish.description: Whether the email appears to be gibberish

disposable.description: Whether the email is from a disposable provider

webmail.description: Whether the email is from a webmail provider

mxRecords.description: Whether MX records are found for the domain

smtpServer.description: Whether the SMTP server is reachable

acceptAll.description: Whether the server accepts all emails

email.description: Email address of the person to enrich

linkedinHandle.description: LinkedIn handle or profile URL of the person

query.description: Natural language search query (e.g., "US-based Software companies"). Automatically maps to structured filters.

totalCount.description: Total number of companies matching the query

domain.description: Domain name to count emails for (e.g., "stripe.com")

companyName.description: Company name to count emails for

total.description: Total number of email addresses found

count.description: Number of emails in this department
Number of emails at this seniority level

leadListId.description: Lead list ID to assign the lead to

limit.description: Number of leads to return (1-1000, default 20)

leadListId.description: Filter leads by a specific list ID

total.description: Total number of leads matching filters

leadId.description: ID of the lead to delete

deleted.description: Whether the lead was successfully deleted

listId.description: List ID (required for get, update, delete)

name.description: List name (required for create and update)

limit.description: Number of lists to return (for list action, 1-100, default 20)

leadsCount.description: Number of leads in the list

list.description: Single list (for get, create, update actions)

leadsCount.description: Number of leads in the list

deleted.description: Whether the list was deleted (for delete action)

emails.description: Email addresses to add as recipients (max 50, for add_recipients)

leadIds.description: Lead IDs to add as recipients (max 50, for add_recipients)

recipientEmail.description: Email of recipient to cancel (for cancel_recipient)

limit.description: Number of results to return (for list and list_recipients)

cancelled.description: Whether scheduled emails were cancelled (for cancel_recipient)

started.description: Whether the sequence was started (for start)

recipientsCount.description: Total recipients in the sequence (for start)
